summary: The indicator slides only for a choice. CI's at-rest Tabs screenshot differed by 3-80 corner pixels between runs of the same commit, for two reasons, each shown failing first: the selected tab's own fill faded out over --ui-duration-fast when the indicator appeared (same colour, same place, nothing visible, but a screenshot could catch it), and the indicator glided whenever the tab was re-measured — a web font arriving, a resize, a reflow — animating something nobody chose. The hand-over is now instant (at Full only the ink transitions; the fill's transition applies at Reduced), and a change of selection opens the slide's transition window, which the slide's end closes.
